warmup.name: Band pass-throughs
warmup.detail: Wide grip, overhead to behind the hips

warmup.name: Scapular pull-ups
warmup.detail: Hang from rack bar, move shoulder blades only, arms straight (keep your feet on the floor for help if needed)

warmup.name: World's greatest stretch
warmup.detail: Lunge, elbow to instep, rotate open

warmup.name: Ramp-up set
warmup.detail: One light set of the first exercise at ~50% effort

exercises.name: Goblet Box Squat
exercises.setup: Set the bench flat behind you. Stand about a foot in front of it with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes turned out slightly. Hold one light dumbbell (4–10 kg) vertically against your chest.
exercises.execution: Sit your hips back and down until you lightly touch the bench, keeping your chest tall and your knees tracking over your toes. Don't drop onto the bench: touch it, pause for a second, then stand up by pushing through your whole foot.
exercises.progression: Add reps up to 3×15. Then slow the lowering to 4 seconds. Then pause for 2 seconds just above the bench without touching it.

exercises.name: Kneeling Band Lat Pulldown
exercises.setup: Loop the yellow band over the rack's pull-up bar so both ends hang down. Kneel underneath it and hold one end in each hand with your arms straight up.
exercises.execution: Pull your shoulder blades down first, then drive your elbows down to your sides until your hands reach shoulder height. Squeeze for a second, then let your arms rise slowly back up without shrugging.
exercises.progression: Kneel a little further back so the band starts with more tension. Then add a 2-second squeeze at the bottom. Then pull one arm at a time.

exercises.name: DB Romanian Deadlift
exercises.setup: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, holding a light dumbbell (4–10 kg) in each hand in front of your thighs.
exercises.execution: With soft knees, push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down the front of your legs, keeping your back flat. Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch (usually around mid-shin), then squeeze your glutes to stand tall.
exercises.progression: Add reps up to 3×15. Then slow the lowering to 4 seconds. Then pause for 2 seconds at the bottom of the stretch.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up (hands on bench)
exercises.setup: Place your hands on the edge of the flat bench, a little wider than your shoulders. Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
exercises.execution: Lower your chest to the edge of the bench with your elbows at about 45° from your body. Keep your hips in line with your shoulders, then push the bench away to return.
exercises.progression: Add reps up to 3×15. Then slow the lowering to 3–4 seconds. Then move to a lower surface (a step, or the floor on your knees), working towards full floor push-ups.

exercises.name: DB Hip Thrust
exercises.setup: Rest your upper back (just below the shoulder blades) across the long side of the flat bench, with your feet flat and hip-width apart. Place a dumbbell (5–10 kg) across your hips and hold it with both hands.
exercises.execution: Tuck your chin and ribs, then drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body is flat from knees to shoulders. Squeeze your glutes for 2 seconds at the top, then lower under control.
exercises.progression: Add reps up to 3×20. Then hold the top for 3 seconds. Then switch to single-leg hip thrusts without the dumbbell.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.setup: Lie on your back on a mat with your arms pointing straight up and your knees bent at 90° above your hips. Gently press your lower back into the floor.
exercises.execution: Slowly reach one arm overhead while straightening the opposite leg until it hovers just above the floor. Keep your lower back pressed down the whole time, then return and switch sides. One reach on each side counts as one rep.
exercises.progression: Slow each reach to 3 seconds. Then hold the stretched position for 2 seconds. Then hold the yellow band between your hands for extra tension.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.setup: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips. Hold the rack upright for balance if you need to.
exercises.execution: Step one foot back and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor, keeping most of your weight on your front foot. Drive through your front heel to return to standing. Finish all reps on one side, then switch.
exercises.progression: Add reps up to 3×12 per leg. Then pause for 1 second at the bottom. Then hold a light dumbbell (2–5 kg) in each hand and log it as +kg.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Bench-Supported DB Row
exercises.setup: Set the bench flat. Put the same-side knee and hand on the bench, with your other foot planted wide. Use a light dumbbell (4–10 kg).
exercises.execution: Let the dumbbell hang until your shoulder blade is stretched forward. Row the dumbbell towards your hip (not your armpit), hold the top for 1 second, then lower slowly.
exercises.progression: Add reps up to 3×15. Then slow the lowering to 4 seconds. Then add a 2-second squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: Seated DB Shoulder Press
exercises.setup: Set the bench to its highest incline (about 80–85°). Start with light dumbbells (2–6 kg) at ear level, palms facing slightly in.
exercises.execution: Press up and slightly in, keeping your ribs down so your back doesn't arch. Lower for 3 seconds back to ear level.
exercises.progression: Add reps up to 3×15. Then pause for 1 second at the bottom. Then press one arm at a time while the other arm holds at the top.

exercises.name: Bench Step-Up
exercises.setup: Stand facing the flat bench (or a stable step) and place one whole foot on it. Make sure the bench can't slide or tip.
exercises.execution: Lean slightly forward and push through the foot on the bench to stand up on it, without pushing off with your back foot. Step down slowly with the same leg you started with, then repeat. Finish all reps on one side, then switch.
exercises.progression: Add reps up to 3×12 per leg. Then lower yourself back down over 3 seconds. Then hold light dumbbells (2–5 kg) at your sides and log them as +kg.

exercises.name: Band Face Pull
exercises.setup: Anchor the band on the rack upright at face height.
exercises.execution: Pull towards your forehead, splitting your hands apart and rotating your knuckles back so your arms end in a 'double biceps' position. Hold 2 seconds and keep your shoulder blades back.
exercises.progression: Step farther from the anchor. Then do 1.5 reps. Then hold the end position for 3 seconds.

exercises.name: Band Pallof Press
exercises.setup: Loop the band around the rack upright at chest height, using a J-hook to stop it sliding. Stand side-on to the rack, far enough away that the band is under tension.
exercises.execution: Brace your core and press your hands straight out from your chest, resisting the pull to twist. Hold 2 seconds with your arms extended, then bring your hands back slowly.
exercises.progression: Step farther from the rack. Then switch to a half-kneeling stance. Then extend the hold to 5 seconds.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.setup: Set the bench flat. Rest the laces of your rear foot on the pad, with your front foot about 2–3 feet in front of the bench. Hold the rack upright for balance at first if you need to.
exercises.execution: Lower your back knee straight down towards the floor, keeping your front heel planted and your chest tall. Pause for 1 second at the bottom, then drive through your whole front foot to stand.
exercises.progression: Add reps up to 3×12 per leg. Then slow the lowering to 3 seconds. Then hold a light dumbbell (4–8 kg) against your chest and log it as +kg.

exercises.name: Incline DB Press
exercises.setup: Set the bench to a 30° incline. Rest light dumbbells (3–8 kg) on your knees, then bring them up as you lie back.
exercises.execution: Lower with your elbows at about 45–60° from your torso until you feel a gentle chest stretch. Press up in a slight arc without clanking the dumbbells together.
exercises.progression: Add reps up to 3×15. Then add a 2-second pause at the bottom. Then do 1.5 reps.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Hamstring Bridge (heel on bench)
exercises.setup: Lie on your back with one heel on the flat bench and your knee bent about 90°. Rest your arms on the floor by your sides.
exercises.execution: Drive your heel down into the bench and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from knee to shoulder. Hold 1 second, then lower for 3 seconds.
exercises.progression: Add reps up to 3×15 per leg. Then straighten your knee a little more for extra hamstring work. Then hold the top for 3 seconds.

exercises.name: Incline Prone DB Row
exercises.setup: Set the bench to about 30–45°. Lie chest-down with your chin just past the top of the pad and a light dumbbell (2–6 kg) in each hand.
exercises.execution: Let your shoulders round forward in the stretch, then pull your elbows back and wide until your shoulder blades meet. Hold 2 seconds at the top.
exercises.progression: Add reps up to 3×15. Then slow the lowering to 4 seconds. Then try Y-raises (thumbs up, arms straight, raising them into a Y).

exercises.name: DB Lateral Raise
exercises.setup: Stand tall with very light dumbbells (2–4 kg) at your sides, palms facing in and knees soft.
exercises.execution: With a slight bend in your elbows, raise your arms out to the sides until your hands reach shoulder height, leading with your elbows. Pause briefly, then lower slowly over 2 seconds.
exercises.progression: Add reps up to 3×15. Then hold the top for 1 second. Then do 1.5 reps (lower halfway, raise again, then lower fully).

exercises.name: Incline DB Curl
exercises.setup: Set the bench to 45–60° so your arms hang behind your torso, with a light dumbbell (2–6 kg) in each hand.
exercises.execution: Curl while keeping your elbows fixed and pointing down. Lower for 3 seconds to a full stretch.
exercises.progression: Add reps up to 3×15. Then hold 1.5 seconds in the stretch at the bottom. Then curl one arm at a time with a pause at the top.

exercises.name: Overhead DB Triceps Extension
exercises.setup: Sit at the highest bench incline and hold one light dumbbell (3–8 kg) with both hands overhead.
exercises.execution: Lower the dumbbell behind your head to a comfortable stretch, keeping your elbows pointing forward. Extend fully without flaring your elbows.
exercises.progression: Add reps up to 3×15. Then hold 1.5 seconds in the stretch. Then add a 2-second squeeze at the top.
